task_groups.title: Sync Handler: Preconditions, Fetch, and Fast-Forward Logic

subtasks.title: Implement sync precondition validation in POST /sync handler
details: Create internal/workspace/sync_handler.go with handler for POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/sync
Check workspace status == 'active'; return HTTP 400 via WriteAPIError if not
Check clone_status == 'ready'; return HTTP 400 via WriteAPIError if not
Check sync_mode != 'disabled'; return HTTP 400 with descriptive error if disabled
Check sync_status != 'syncing'; return HTTP 409 via WriteAPIError if already syncing
Return HTTP 404 if workspace not found

subtasks.title: Implement deferred cleanup and sync_status='syncing' transition
details: After precondition checks pass, set sync_status='syncing' in DB
Register a deferred function (defer) that checks if context was cancelled and sets sync_status='error' with descriptive sync_error if so
Deferred cleanup must run before handler returns to prevent stuck 'syncing' state
Use context.Err() to detect cancellation in the deferred function

subtasks.title: Implement go-git fetch with credential resolution and unshallow retry
details: Open local repo at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ using go-git PlainOpen
Call resolveCloneAuth(ctx, workspace) from internal/workspace/clone_auth.go to get fetch credentials
Call remote.Fetch() with resolved auth options
If fetch fails due to shallow clone missing history, retry with unshallow fetch (fetch all history); log warning on retry
If fetch fails for other reasons (network, auth), set sync_status='error', record sync_error, return HTTP 502

subtasks.title: Implement upstream HEAD SHA read and fast-forward eligibility check
details: After successful fetch, read upstream HEAD SHA from go-git remote tracking ref
Update upstream_head_sha in DB immediately (always, regardless of fast-forward outcome)
Compare upstream HEAD with local integration branch HEAD using go-git commit graph ancestry check
If equal: set sync_status='idle', update last_sync_at, return workspace
If upstream is descendant of local: fast-forward integration branch via go-git ref update, update head_sha, set sync_status='idle', update last_sync_at
If diverged: set sync_status='error', sync_error='upstream history has diverged; use --reset-to-upstream to recover', return HTTP 409
